nom: Exuviance HydraSoothe Refresh Toner with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.titre: Works on my Super Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: I have the MOST sensitive skin ever. Generally, I can only keep a 2-step skincare routine, as anything more breaks me out. In the morning, I rinse my face, neck and chest with water, pat dry, and apply an SPF that is also a great moisturizer. At night, I wash my face with Simple brand and apply La Roche Posay double repair moisturizer. However, after a round of probiotics caused an insane amount of greasy, painful breakouts on my face and down my neck, I needed to do something extra to help heal my skin. After research, I found that PHAs are safe for sensitive skin and helps with cell turnover to clear up the skin. I bought this toner specifically because it has PHAs. The hyaluronic acid is a nice bonus. I use this every night after I wash my face, BUT I dampen my face, neck, and chest before applying. This helps to reintroduce moisture in my skin and dilute the toner to make it easier for my skin to handle. I have noticed a huge improvement in the acne scars on my neck from the probiotic breakout, AND I am having very few breakouts on my face now! It took about 2 weeks to start making improvements, but my skin is looking better than it has in a long time. I'm optimistic that it will help me return my skin health to a balanced state.
This toner feels refreshing and not astringent. Just a cool clean feel without tingling or stinging.
Amazing product. Very high quality. My doctor recommended this ages ago.

I was looking for a toner for the first time, and I have normal skin, sometimes dry and/or oily. At first this made my face a little red but after a few uses it had a soothing feeling and made my face feel cool without any burning. May buy again but may look for something different, definitely okay! Also I like the smell lol
I bought this over 2 months ago. I was skeptical at first but it works very well on my cheeks that are normally dry and sensitive to other products.

I was recommended this product by an Ulta employee after I explanied that I've had a lot of flaky, dry skin on and around my mouth and nose. So far, this product has made my skin feel rejuvinated and hydrated from the usual dryness I experience. I haven't used a toner in a few years, so I'm hoping this will help exfoliate the dead skin off my face like the employee said it would. I just got the product yesterday and have only used it once, which is the reason I only gave it 4 stars. I will write another review in a couple weeks to see if its held up and I'll paste this review to the top of the new review.

I used it yesterday for the first time after washing with the Gentle Cleansing Face Wash for sensitive skin. Almost immediately my face felt amazing! The redness I get on my cheeks went away and my skin looked so good.

avis.titre: I really wanted to love this
avis.texte: This burns so bad. It smells great but it dried out my skin, my skin is now flakey. Definitely not for sensitive skin!

The Rep suggested I stop using harsh acne cleanser and try their gentle cleanser and this toner. My nose was red and flaky and this is a good toner to use after cleansing. It is good for over treated oily skin. I'm on my third bottle!
The best toner for sensitive skin. I have been using Exuviance products for years. This toner pairs well with the Gentle Cream Cleanser.
I have skin allergies and rosacea. I've bought my second bottle of this toner. It helps my skins texture and deep cleans my pores without irritation.
It takes off leftover makeup and my face feels fresh after using it. It doesn't sting my face like the witch hazel and acne products I used. This is good for my combo skin and flakiness.

avis.titre: Noticed the change in two weeks
avis.texte: Not all toner is okay for everyone skin, but this is perfect for me.

this product specifically states good for sensitive skin. Unfortunately this did not mean my sensitive skin. Immediately after putting on, my face started to burn and turned red like a very bad sunburn. it dried and fried my skin. I have dry and sensitive skin brought on by perimenopause. I have fair skin and burn easily.

avis.titre: There's Better Toners on the Market
avis.texte: I don't think this is very "soothing," since the acids in it gave my sensitive skin more of a "cooling" and slightly stinging reaction. It also has a rather strong scent reminding me a little of a Pina Colada. It's not the worst toner, but definitely not soothing in my opinion. I will not be buying again.

I changed from the birth control pill to an IUD about a year prior to using this product... with this change, I began to struggle with cystic acne for the first time in my life. They popped up on my chin at a minimum of two times per month. And they hurt so bad! An esthetician recommended using this product, so I gave it a try. I had used everything from other high-end skincare acne lines to home remedies. I actually had a cystic acne spot on my chin the day I bought this product, so I decided to use it that night. Woke up the next morning and the spot was gone! I have been using for 2 weeks (I use this every other night & just on my "acne" areas) and have yet to have another cystic acne spot or any breakout since that date. I am in awe & so thankful!!!!
Was supposed to hydrate, it dried out my skin. It had added unnecessary colorant. My skin looked worse after using it. This will be going back.
This is a great winter toner for combo sensitive skin! Toners always make me react in some way but this is just pure refreshing. Will be repurchasing soon.

Makes me feel so hydrated, beautiful and clean! It's not sticky, thick or glorified water. Been using for a while and this brand is actually doing something for my skin rather than me throwing away money on random products that promise to help.
This is a great toner!! Works well to help maintain oil without stripping the skin. This is a good every day toner. It's worth the money. Awesome for sensitive skin!!

I tried this on a whim, after deciding to add a toner to my routine. I made sure the ingredients weren't going to give me too much trouble. While my skin did have a slight reaction when I first started using it, I wasn't surprised since I always have a reaction when I try something new. I am almost on my second bottle, I love how my skin feels throughout the day. It absorbs nicely. I have noticed my extremely oily skin is under control after using this for about a week in the AM and PM. By the end of the day my entire face would look wet from my oil production, before I added this toner. Now my cheeks have become normal and my nose and forehead still get a slight shine, but nothing I'm mad about. I actually like the slight shine. Very happy I went with this toner!
I have been using Clinique for years, I really like the way this product works and feels on my skin.
Smells great, but doesn't smell too strong. The texture is nice when it goes on and drys/absorbs very well. My skin feels great after using it. Highly recommend!
This is my favorite toner. I'm super sensitive & it doesnt break me out & actually hydrates my skin. Love it!!

An Ulta clerk, Bret, recommended this several years ago. He was so insistent that he made a sample for me to take home.I have been using it ever since. My skin is clearer, my rosacea is better, my pores are smaller.I don't know how I ever got along without it. Thank you, Bret!
After ceanning my face, this toner refreshes it beautifully and makes it feel cool and clean

I bought this toner after it was recommended to me by a sales associate in Ulta. She has eczema just as I do and said I must try it! I've been using it for 3 months now and it has changed my life!! It's so refreshing, and gentle on my sensitive skin. Anyone with eczema knows how important it is to be careful what you put on your face. I'm never going back!! I recommend anyone with dry sensitive skin to use this toner! 10/10!! ❤️❤️❤️
I've been using this product for over a year and it's probably my favorite toner. It works so well and isn't irritating at all.

avis.titre: I like this product very much
avis.texte: I use it to take off my makeup. It is very soothing, not irratating to my face.
I use this product twice a day & I absolutely love it. It's super great for sensitive skin, I definitely recommend it!
It make my skin feel hydrated after washing and removes the excess dirt.
This product is amazing for my sensitive and dry skin. Finally found a toner that doesn't dry me out and actually makes me feel clean. Will be the only toner I use from now on.
This is the most soothing and refreshing Toning lotion that I have ever used.
Use this toner after cleansing my skin to prepare my face for my moisturizer or anti-aging product. Leaves skin feeling clean and refreshed.

I bought this toner because PHA is supposed to be less irritating than AHA and BHA. I used this for a week, and by the end of the week, I had bumpy, irritated skin, and FOUR cystic pimples. This was the only thing that I changed in my routine. Returned immediately.

Bought the toner and cleanser based on a recommendation from an Ulta rep. Dried out my naturally dry skin to the point that no moisturizer was strong enough to combat the dry. Would recommend for normal to oily skin only.

This product claims to help with texture and I believe it does but I can't be positive because the cleanser I incorporated into my morning routine does as well. It's supposed to gently exfoliate while adding hydration which is what caught my attention on the website. Most toners I've tried are either glorified rose water that does very little for the skin OR are harsh astringents that do the opposite of what their bottles claim because they're too harsh and drying. This is perfect because it balances PH and exfoliates (which is my ultimate toner dream) WITHOUT alcohols that strip my skin and end up making my skin oilier and more likely to break out. It also smells wonderful! I can't place the scent because it's so faint but I want to say vanilla. It's orange in color and you're supposed to apply it with a cotton pad but I like to splash it on my face and press it in like an essence so I don't irritate my skin. It's a bit thicker than traditional liquid toners but it absorbs quickly and really does hydrate the skin so it's my new favorite toner and I'm so happy to have found it, my skin LOVES it! I received the product free from Exuviance. The opinions expressed in this review are my own.
I absolutely love how gentle this is on my skin. It leaves my skin so hydrated and looks full of life. I received the product free from Exuviance. The opinions expressed in this review are my own.

I've been using this toner for a few weeks now and am definitely seeing a difference in my pores. I use it as part of my nightly routine after I cleanse and it really just makes everything nice and tight.

Received this toner as a part of a promotional package if I purchased another product. It's gentle and does not irritate my sensitive skin. I have been using it daily with the other products. I may or may not purchase this item on its own in the future.

I received this product for free from exuviance and exchange of my honest opinion. i have dry sensitive skin and this has worked like a charm to my skin. I love using this after i wash my face. Makes my skin feel so soft and it hydrates my skin beautifully. I am all in for hydration. You got a ton of product for the price. The smell is not so strong. I just love using this after cleasing my skin.

avis.titre: i have used this product for years
avis.texte: I splurge on Exuviance toner and cream cleanser because it leaves my sensitive skin feeling hydrated and clean.
I love this, this is my favorite toner. I use for the last 4 years.

avis.titre: I have been using this product for years.
avis.texte: The only product that I like, I had tried other products but keep going back.

avis.titre: Nice product, but has fragrance and algae extract.
avis.texte: This product has some really nice ingredients and very gentle exfoliation. I stopped using because of the added frangrance, and algae extract which can be very irritating and pore clogging.

This toner has been great, and I will probably re-purchase. I have very sensitive skin and rosacea on combination skin. I have not experienced any breakouts, and I have fewer dry patches. I'm giving it 4 instead of 5 because I haven't really noticed any exfoliation. (Perhaps the gentleness makes the exfoliation subtle.)

Toners usually feel drying on my skin, this I feel makes my skin tighten but not dry, and feels fresh and clean. Cleanses away last bits of makeup that didn't get removed from facial cleanser. Great product!

I absolutely love this product! I was in Ulta looking for a toner years ago, as I was new to toners at the time, and wanted to add one to my skincare regime. The Ulta SA recommended me this one and I have been using it ever since. I have tried other toners here and there over the years, but I always find myself coming back to this one. It is gentle, yet effective. It removes any leftover residue, surface oils that I wake up with, without drying the skin out. It has no overpowering scent and leaves my skin feeling fresh and hydrated. Plus it is Alcohol-free!

I've been using this product for two weeks. I have sensitive skin and it works great for me. Leaves me feeling clean and moisturized. I use it every morning and night. Its a staple in my cleansing routine. Love it and will be trying more products from this line.

Research says skin adapts to regularly used products so is good to switch up when you stop seeing results - after 4 years of use of my loved skin care, I thought time to use something new - Exuviance Line (unique to ULTA) was the recommended choice. I LOVE the complete line! I am amazed at the improvement in my 66 year old skin - hydration, skin texture, smoothness and softening of lines and wrinkles. I strongly recommend this complete line. AMAZING!
Even though this was not necessarily a budget friendly purchase, it is worth every penny!

avis.titre: I little too much for me
avis.texte: This felt very moisturizing but left a film behind that was a little too much for my sensitive skin. I have sensitive skin but more normal to combination side.
The product feels good when you use it. Non drying and refreshing

This product goes great in combination with a dark spot syrum, it accentuates the toning and makes your skin glow. I noticed that my normally enlarged pores shrunk to a much less noticeable size and I use this toner with this brands clarifying cleanser and I get ABSOLUTELY NO BREAKOUTS. I have very oily skin and when you have large pores and oily skin, it's a nightmare. Great products, highly recommended.
